title: T3 Ops: overview film
description: One screen for the whole fleet. A narrated tour of T3 Ops on demo data, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 63 seconds: T3 Ops. Core, extensions and advisories; Staging first, release second; Before and after, pixel by pixel; A checklist with 64 items. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Twenty-two TYPO3 sites, one security advisory, and every update done by hand.
T3 Ops runs the whole fleet from one screen.
Four times a day it checks core, extensions and advisories.
An update runs on a staging copy first: backup, Composer, deploy, screenshots.
Before and after shots of every sampled page, compared pixel by pixel.
A 64-point hardening checklist, from the Install Tool to security headers.
Monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana and Uptime Kuma. Nightly encrypted backups, verified every morning. Cloudflare cache purged after each release.
T3 Ops. Updates you can prove.
